hypothesis: Continue the same five SGDM trajectories with fixed settings to 200,000 total updates to measure long-horizon predictive performance and confidence-tail-weighted alpha.
authorization: User requested a very long SGD plus momentum experiment to 200,000 updates on 2026-11-26. This is a prespecified horizon extension, not a new hyperparameter search.
schedule: constant learning rate; no early stopping; continue full optimizer, RNG, sampler, and model state from 100,000 updates

spectral.note: The 784x784 hidden matrix is the sole eligible matrix. The weighted average equals its ordinary fitted alpha; no layer dispersion is defined.

comparison_policy.primary: Fixed 200,000-update results from all five unchanged original SGDM seeds. Compare paired 20,000, 100,000, and 200,000 checkpoints.
comparison_policy.selection_window: Optional minimum-validation model in [100,000,200,000] only, reported separately from fixed-budget endpoints; no test or alpha selection.
comparison_policy.reference: The original native and modified AdamW runs stop at 20,000; any 200,000-update SGDM comparison has unequal compute and is not an optimizer-only causal comparison.
comparison_policy.uncertainty: Equal-weight seed means, sample SD, and two-sided 95% Student-t confidence intervals across five seeds, conditional on the fixed data split.
comparison_policy.runtime: Restore exact saved model/optimizer/RNG/sampler state. Verify numerical package/precision/thread settings; record any CPU/hardware change without claiming cross-hardware bitwise identity.
